name: Ambassador
job: Ambassador referral flow. Referred person is created as a new contact and is never merged with the referrer. Re-enters WF-01. Uses the live ambassador-referral tag.

trigger.notes: Also triggered on inbound ambassador form submission via Contact Created.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: Added by WF-06 at T+21 (ambassador ask)
named_steps.comment: Asks the member to refer someone. Must not write to the referrer's opportunity.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: On ambassador form submitted (referred contact created)
named_steps.comment: Reads the ambassador form submission. Referred contact is created via the form; must not merge with the referrer.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: ambassador-referral (live tag on referred contact)
named_steps.comment: Live tag. Must not rename ambassador-referral.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_ref_ambassador (referred contact audit)
named_steps.comment: New v2 audit tag on the referred contact.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Re-enter WF-01 for referred contact
named_steps.comment: Referred contact enters the normal Lead Capture flow. Must not create a Sales opp here; WF-01 owns create-once.
